title: Hotel chlorine incident: hotel named, date set to the day it happened
what_changed: The Register (16 November) names the hotel as Hotel Ling Bao at Phantasialand in Brühl and says the incident happened on Friday (13 November); the record had an unnamed hotel, a country-level pin and the article date 15 November. Added hospital figures from both outlets (The Register: five; Security Affairs: four) and The Register's note that Microsoft ruled out cybercriminals.
